$comment: FIXTURE: schemas that already carry a `not` keyword and are either hot (reached) or hollowed. Only `$defs` of this module are referenced, so the module body - including the root's own unreached `not` - is dropped and the root is hollowed; the hollow marker `not` must not collide with the original one.
title: Used not keyword
description: A module whose schemas carry a `not` keyword.

not.$comment: Unreached `not` on a schema that gets hollowed -> dropped BEFORE the hollow marker is written, so there is no collision.
not.title: Forbidden body
not.description: Rejects an object that has a forbidden property.

hotWithNot.$comment: Reached from main. A hot schema loses nothing but unreached `$defs`, so the `not` and its content survive untouched - while `not/$defs/droppedInNot` is removed.
hotWithNot.title: Hot with not
hotWithNot.description: A string that must not be the forbidden value.

not.title: Forbidden value
not.description: The one value that is not allowed.

hollowedWithNot.$comment: NOT reached itself, only its `$defs/inner` is. Its original `not` is unreached -> dropped together with `type`; afterwards the schema is hollowed, i.e. gets the marker `not`. The marker must never merge with or sit next to the original `not`.
hollowedWithNot.title: Hollowed with not
hollowedWithNot.description: A container whose own constraints are no longer in use.

inner.$comment: Reached from main -> kept; forces the parent to be hollowed instead of removed.
inner.title: Inner

hotWithBooleanNot.$comment: Reached from main. `not` is the BOOLEAN schema `true` (= nothing ever validates). Booleans are not schema objects, so `subschemas()` never yields them; the sweep must keep the key as is and never turn it into `null`, `{}` or a marker object.
hotWithBooleanNot.title: Hot with boolean not
hotWithBooleanNot.description: A schema that rejects everything by negating `true`.

hollowedWithBooleanNot.$comment: NOT reached itself, only its `$defs/inner` is. The BOOLEAN `not: false` is unreached -> dropped (a bare boolean is swept away like any unreached scalar); afterwards the schema is hollowed with the marker `not`. No collision, and the marker must be an object - not the original boolean.
hollowedWithBooleanNot.title: Hollowed with boolean not
hollowedWithBooleanNot.description: A container whose boolean `not` is no longer in use.

inner.$comment: Reached from main -> kept; forces the parent to be hollowed instead of removed.
inner.title: Inner

alreadyHollowTrueNot.$comment: NOT reached itself, only its `$defs/inner` is. `not: true` already rejected everything, so the schema was hollow before the sweep. The marker replaces the boolean, but this schema must NOT appear in `hollowed`, and `…/not` must NOT appear in `removed`.
alreadyHollowTrueNot.title: Already hollow true not
alreadyHollowTrueNot.description: A container that already rejected everything via `not: true`.

inner.$comment: Reached from main -> kept; forces the parent to be kept as a container.
inner.title: Inner

alreadyHollowEmptyNot.$comment: NOT reached itself, only its `$defs/inner` is. The `not` is an annotations-only object, which accepts anything, so the schema was hollow before the sweep. Same expectations as alreadyHollowTrueNot.
alreadyHollowEmptyNot.title: Already hollow empty not
alreadyHollowEmptyNot.description: A container that already rejected everything via an annotations-only `not`.

not.title: Anything
not.description: Accepts anything - so negating it rejects everything.

inner.$comment: Reached from main -> kept; forces the parent to be kept as a container.
inner.title: Inner
